scripts.features: A helpful script for respawn the pallet so fast as your ping helps with fightes and you can move the button just for one time
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
local Event = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("MenuToys"):WaitForChild("SpawnToyRemoteFunction")

local targetPart = Instance.new("Part")
targetPart.Name = "NeonTargetIndicator"
targetPart.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
targetPart.Size = Vector3.new(1.5, 1.5, 1.5)
targetPart.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
targetPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
targetPart.CanCollide = false
targetPart.Anchored = true
targetPart.Parent = Workspace

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local character = player.Character
    if not character or not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
    
    local camCFrame = camera.CFrame
    local lookVector = camCFrame.LookVector
    
    local pitch = math.asin(lookVector.Y)
    local alpha = math.clamp((-pitch) / (math.pi / 2), 0, 1)
    local fixedOffset = -0.66 + (alpha * (-14.9 - (-0.66)))
    
    local finalPosition = camCFrame.Position + (lookVector * fixedOffset)
    targetPart.Position = finalPosition
end)

local pg = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", pg)
gui.Name = "FastUI"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true

local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", gui)
btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 55, 0, 55)
btn.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.4, 0)
btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
btn.Text = "7S"
btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 160)
btn.TextSize = 16
btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
btn.Active = true
btn.Draggable = false

local c = Instance.new("UICorner", btn)
c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

local s = Instance.new("UIStroke", btn)
s.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
s.Thickness = 2

local dragging, dInput, dStart, sPos, moved = false, nil, nil, nil, false

btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(io)
    if not moved and (io.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or io.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        dragging = true
        dStart = io.Position
        sPos = btn.Position
        io.Changed:Connect(function()
            if io.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End and dragging then
                dragging = false
                moved = true
            end
        end)
    end
end)

btn.InputChanged:Connect(function(io)
    if not moved and (io.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or io.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        dInput = io
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(io)
    if not moved and dragging and io == dInput then
        local delta = io.Position - dStart
        btn.Position = UDim2.new(sPos.X.Scale, sPos.X.Offset + delta.X, sPos.Y.Scale, sPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end
end)

btn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
    if not dragging then
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)
    end
end)

btn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
end)

btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if dragging then return end
    
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end
    
    task.spawn(function()
        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
        
        local spawnPosition = targetPart.Position
        local camCFrame = camera.CFrame
        local _, yaw, _ = camCFrame:ToOrientation()
        
        local newCFrame = camCFrame.Rotation + spawnPosition
        local rotationVector = Vector3.new(0, math.deg(yaw), 0)
        
        pcall(function()
            Event:InvokeServer(
                "PalletLightBrown",
                newCFrame,
                rotationVector
            )
        end)
    end)
end)

scripts.title: Teleport FREE
scripts.features:
TeleportFREE — универсальный клиентский скрипт меток и телепорта для любой игры Roblox.

ФУНКЦИИ
• Постановка меток взглядом (raycast) или под собой
• Список меток: выбор, телепорт и удаление по каждой
• Телепорт к выбранной или к последней метке
• Настраиваемые клавиши (меню, метка, TP, удаление)
• Неоновый столб + сфера + кольцо + луч к игроку
• Имя на Billboard, дистанция в studs, rainbow и пульсация
• Плавный телепорт + смещение по Y
• Лимит меток, автовыбор новой метки
• Режим Parent = Camera (удобнее в играх с защитой)
• Анимированный экран загрузки
• Современное GUI с вкладками: Marks | Settings | Binds

КЛАВИШИ ПО УМОЛЧАНИЮ
• RightShift — открыть / закрыть меню
• G — поставить метку (по взгляду)
• T — телепорт к выбранной
• Y — телепорт к последней
• X — удалить последнюю метку

local dragging = false

local startPos = nil

local function updateDrag(input)
    local delta = input.Position - dragStart
    Main.Position = UDim2.new(
        startPos.X.Scale,
        startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
        startPos.Y.Scale,
        startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
    )
end

DragArea.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = Main.Position

        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

DragArea.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then

    if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then

    end
end)

    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = false
        resizing = false
    end
end)

--// RESIZE
local resizing = false
local resizeStart = nil
local startSize = nil

local function updateResize(input)
    local delta = input.Position - resizeStart
    local newWidth = math.clamp(startSize.X.Offset + delta.X, MIN_WIDTH, MAX_WIDTH)
    local newHeight = math.clamp(startSize.Y.Offset + delta.Y, MIN_HEIGHT, MAX_HEIGHT)

	["Left Shoulder"] = 0,
	["Right Hip"] = 0,
	["Right Shoulder"] = 0
}
local TS = game:GetService("TweenService")

local function getnext(tbl, number)
	local closestDiff = math.huge
	local closestValue = 0
	for i, v in pairs(tbl) do
		if i > number and i - number < closestDiff then
			closestDiff = i - number
			closestValue = i
		end
	end
	return closestValue
end

local function kftotbl(kf)
	local tbl3 = {}
	for _, v in pairs(kf:GetDescendants()) do
		if v:IsA("Pose") then
			tbl3[string.sub(v.Name, 1, 1) .. string.sub(v.Name, #v.Name, #v.Name)] = v.CFrame
		end
	end
	return tbl3
end

local function getSpeed(lastTimeStamp, currentTimeStamp)
	if currentTimeStamp == 0 then return 0 end
	return math.abs(lastTimeStamp - currentTimeStamp)
end

local function getAnimation(animationId)
	local animationObject
	local success, errorMsg = pcall(function()
		animationObject = game:GetObjects(animationId)[1]
	end)
	if not success then
		return nil
	end
	return animationObject
end

local Main = {}
Main.__index = Main

function Main.LoadDummy(DummyChar)
	local metatable = {}
	setmetatable(metatable, Main)
	metatable.char = DummyChar
	return metatable
end

function Main:LoadAnimation(animationId)
	local Character = self.char
	local animationObject = getAnimation(animationId)
	if not animationObject then return end
	local metatable = {}
	setmetatable(metatable, Main)
	metatable.char = Character
	metatable.animObject = animationObject
	return metatable
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Player = Players.LocalPlayer

Connection = game.Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(c)
	if c.Name == "Animate" and c.Parent == Player.Character then
		c.Enabled = false   
		Connection:Disconnect()
	end
end)

			LS.Enabled = false
		end
	end
end)

	if RealChar:FindFirstChild("Torso") then
		for MotorName, Motor6DAngle in pairs(Motors) do
			if RealChar:FindFirstChild("Torso"):FindFirstChild(MotorName) then
				RealChar:FindFirstChild("Torso"):FindFirstChild(MotorName).CurrentAngle = Motor6DAngle
			end
		end
	end

local function SetAngles()
	if FakeCharacter:FindFirstChild("Torso") then
		for MotorName, Motor6DAngle in pairs(Motors) do
			if FakeCharacter:FindFirstChild("Torso"):FindFirstChild(MotorName) then
				local Motor = FakeCharacter:FindFirstChild("Torso"):FindFirstChild(MotorName)

			end

scripts.title: Rayu hub (aimbot) BETA
scripts.features: My first script, I hope you enjoy it. Aimbot!
scripts.script:
--============================================================
--  RAYU HUB - UI Moderna com Aimbot
--  Autor: Rayu Hub
--  Coloque em: StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts (LocalScript)
--============================================================

-- Serviços
local Players            = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService         = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService   = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService       = game:GetService("TweenService")

local LocalPlayer        = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera             = workspace.CurrentCamera

--============================================================
-- VARIÁVEIS DE ESTADO
--============================================================
local AimbotAtivo    = false
local FOVRaio        = 120      -- valor inicial do círculo
local VelocidadeCam  = 0.25     -- suavidade da câmera (menor = mais rápido)
local AlvoAtual      = nil

--============================================================
-- CRIAÇÃO DA INTERFACE (ScreenGui)
--============================================================
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "RayuHub"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
ScreenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

--============================================================
-- FRAME PRINCIPAL (arrastável, cantos arredondados)
--============================================================
local Main = Instance.new("Frame")
Main.Name = "MainFrame"
Main.Size = UDim2.new(0, 320, 0, 260)
Main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -160, 0.5, -130)
Main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 30)
Main.BorderSizePixel = 0
Main.Active = true
Main.Draggable = true -- já vem com drag nativo
Main.Parent = ScreenGui

local MainCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
MainCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
MainCorner.Parent = Main

-- Borda sutil
local MainStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
MainStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 90)
MainStroke.Thickness = 1
MainStroke.Transparency = 0.4
MainStroke.Parent = Main

-- Gradiente no topo (efeito profissional)
local TopGradient = Instance.new("Frame")
TopGradient.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 60)
TopGradient.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 45)
TopGradient.BorderSizePixel = 0
TopGradient.Parent = Main

local TopGradientCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
TopGradientCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
TopGradientCorner.Parent = TopGradient

--============================================================
-- TÍTULO "Rayu Hub"
--============================================================
local Titulo = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Titulo.Name = "Titulo"
Titulo.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 60)
Titulo.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Titulo.Text = "RAYU HUB"
Titulo.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Titulo.TextSize = 26
Titulo.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
Titulo.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
Titulo.Parent = Main

-- Gradiente de texto (fica elegante)
local TituloGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
TituloGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new{
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(120, 180, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(200, 120, 255)),
}
TituloGradient.Parent = Titulo

-- Linha divisória
local Divider = Instance.new("Frame")
Divider.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 1)
Divider.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 60)
Divider.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 90)
Divider.BorderSizePixel = 0
Divider.Parent = Main

--============================================================
-- BOTÃO AIMBOT (Toggle com indicador ON/OFF)
--============================================================
local BotaoAimbot = Instance.new("TextButton")
BotaoAimbot.Name = "BotaoAimbot"
BotaoAimbot.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 50)
BotaoAimbot.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 80)
BotaoAimbot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 50)
BotaoAimbot.BorderSizePixel = 0
BotaoAimbot.Text = ""
BotaoAimbot.AutoButtonColor = false
BotaoAimbot.Parent = Main

local BotaoAimbotCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
BotaoAimbotCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
BotaoAimbotCorner.Parent = BotaoAimbot

-- Texto do botão
local TextoBotao = Instance.new("TextLabel")
TextoBotao.Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 1, 0)
TextoBotao.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 0)
TextoBotao.BackgroundTransparency = 1
TextoBotao.Text = "Aimbot"
TextoBotao.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
TextoBotao.TextSize = 16
TextoBotao.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 240)
TextoBotao.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
TextoBotao.Parent = BotaoAimbot

-- Indicador ON/OFF
local Indicador = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Indicador.Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 26)
Indicador.Position = UDim2.new(1, -75, 0.5, -13)
Indicador.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 80)
Indicador.Text = "OFF"
Indicador.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Indicador.TextSize = 13
Indicador.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210)
Indicador.Parent = BotaoAimbot

local IndicadorCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
IndicadorCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 13)
IndicadorCorner.Parent = Indicador

--============================================================
-- SEÇÃO FOV (Label + TextBox)
--============================================================
local LabelFOV = Instance.new("TextLabel")
LabelFOV.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 20)
LabelFOV.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 145)
LabelFOV.BackgroundTransparency = 1
LabelFOV.Text = "Tamanho do FOV"
LabelFOV.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
LabelFOV.TextSize = 13
LabelFOV.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 180)
LabelFOV.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
LabelFOV.Parent = Main

local TextBoxFOV = Instance.new("TextBox")
TextBoxFOV.Name = "TextBoxFOV"
TextBoxFOV.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 45)
TextBoxFOV.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 170)
TextBoxFOV.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 50)
TextBoxFOV.BorderSizePixel = 0
TextBoxFOV.Text = tostring(FOVRaio)
TextBoxFOV.PlaceholderText = "Digite o valor..."
TextBoxFOV.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
TextBoxFOV.TextSize = 15
TextBoxFOV.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 240)
TextBoxFOV.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 140)
TextBoxFOV.ClearTextOnFocus = false
TextBoxFOV.Parent = Main

local TextBoxCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
TextBoxCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
TextBoxCorner.Parent = TextBoxFOV

local TextBoxStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
TextBoxStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 90)
TextBoxStroke.Thickness = 1
TextBoxStroke.Transparency = 0.5
TextBoxStroke.Parent = TextBoxFOV

-- Rodapé com status
local Rodape = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Rodape.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 20)
Rodape.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 1, -28)
Rodape.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Rodape.Text = "v1.0  •  Rayu Hub"
Rodape.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
Rodape.TextSize = 11
Rodape.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 130)
Rodape.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
Rodape.Parent = Main

--============================================================
-- CÍRCULO DE FOV (centralizado na tela, em ScreenGui separado)
--============================================================
local FOVGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
FOVGui.Name = "RayuFOV"
FOVGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
FOVGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
FOVGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local CirculoFOV = Instance.new("Frame")
CirculoFOV.Name = "CirculoFOV"
CirculoFOV.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
CirculoFOV.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
CirculoFOV.Size = UDim2.new(0, FOVRaio * 2, 0, FOVRaio * 2)
CirculoFOV.BackgroundTransparency = 1
CirculoFOV.Visible = false
CirculoFOV.Parent = FOVGui

local CirculoCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
CirculoCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
CirculoCorner.Parent = CirculoFOV

local CirculoStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
CirculoStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 180, 255)
CirculoStroke.Thickness = 1.5
CirculoStroke.Transparency = 0.2
CirculoStroke.Parent = CirculoFOV

--============================================================
-- FUNÇÃO: atualizar tamanho do círculo
--============================================================
local function AtualizarFOV()
    CirculoFOV.Size = UDim2.new(0, FOVRaio * 2, 0, FOVRaio * 2)
end

--============================================================
-- FUNÇÃO: alternar estado do Aimbot (visual do botão)
--============================================================
local function AtualizarVisualBotao()
    if AimbotAtivo then
        TweenService:Create(BotaoAimbot, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 90, 70),
        }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(Indicador, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 140),
            TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 30, 20),
        }):Play()
        Indicador.Text = "ON"
        CirculoFOV.Visible = true
    else
        TweenService:Create(BotaoAimbot, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 50),
        }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(Indicador, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 80),
            TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210),
        }):Play()
        Indicador.Text = "OFF"
        CirculoFOV.Visible = false
        AlvoAtual = nil
    end
end

--============================================================
-- CLIQUE NO BOTÃO AIMBOT
--============================================================
BotaoAimbot.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    AimbotAtivo = not AimbotAtivo
    AtualizarVisualBotao()
end)

-- Efeito de hover no botão
BotaoAimbot.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
    if not AimbotAtivo then
        TweenService:Create(BotaoAimbot, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 65),
        }):Play()
    end
end)
BotaoAimbot.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
    if not AimbotAtivo then
        TweenService:Create(BotaoAimbot, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 50),
        }):Play()
    end
end)

--============================================================
-- TEXTBOX: atualizar FOV em tempo real
--============================================================
TextBoxFOV:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
    local Numero = tonumber(TextBoxFOV.Text)
    if Numero and Numero > 0 and Numero <= 1000 then
        FOVRaio = Numero
        AtualizarFOV()
        TextBoxStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 90)
    else
        -- Feedback visual de erro
        TextBoxStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 80, 80)
    end
end)

--============================================================
-- LÓGICA DO AIMBOT
--============================================================
-- Retorna o jogador mais próximo dentro do FOV
local function ObterAlvo()
    local MaisProximo = nil
    local MenorDistancia = FOVRaio
    local CentroTela = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)

    for _, Player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if Player ~= LocalPlayer and Player.Character then
            local Head = Player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            local Humanoid = Player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

            if Head and Humanoid and Humanoid.Health > 0 then
                -- Projeta posição da cabeça na tela
                local PosTela, NaTela = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(Head.Position)
                if NaTela then
                    -- Verifica se está do lado certo da câmera
                    local Direcao = (Head.Position - Camera.CFrame.Position).Unit
                    local Facing = Camera.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(Direcao)
                    if Facing > 0 then
                        local Dist = (Vector2.new(PosTela.X, PosTela.Y) - CentroTela).Magnitude
                        if Dist < MenorDistancia then
                            MenorDistancia = Dist
                            MaisProximo = Head
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return MaisProximo
end

-- Loop de atualização da câmera (prioridade alta)
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not AimbotAtivo then return end

    local Alvo = ObterAlvo()
    if Alvo then
        AlvoAtual = Alvo
        -- Suaviza a câmera mirando na cabeça
        local PosAlvo = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, Alvo.Position)
        Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame:Lerp(PosAlvo, VelocidadeCam)
    else
        AlvoAtual = nil
    end
end)

--============================================================
-- ATUALIZAÇÃO INICIAL
--============================================================
AtualizarFOV()
AtualizarVisualBotao()

scripts.title: Auto Pick Up Egg, Auto Hatch , Auto Feed and more
scripts.features:
The "Ride A Pet" script, operated through the ZD Hub interface, provides an extensive automation suite designed to efficiently farm eggs and acquire highly rare pets. The script is optimized to streamline the core gameplay loop of collecting, hatching, and placing eggs to maximize in-game earnings.
Core Automation Features:
 * Auto Farm Loop: Automates the complete gameplay cycle by tweening the player to an egg, picking it up, hatching it, tweening back to the baseplate, and placing the egg.
 * Select Rarity: Includes a filtering system that allows users to target specific eggs and pets based on their rarity tiers.
 * Rollback Egg: Optimizes farming by repeatedly picking up and hatching the same egg before returning to base, as long as that egg remains active.
 * Auto Pickup (Standalone): Continuously collects any nearby active eggs without initiating the tweening movement sequence.
Movement and Configuration Settings:
 * Travel and Return Times: Users can precisely configure the travel duration to an egg (defaulting to 5 seconds) and set a maximum travel duration for returning to the baseplate (defaulting to 3 seconds).
 * Custom Speeds: The script allows customization of both the "Tween Speed" when traveling to eggs and the "Return Speed" back to the base, measured in studs per second.
